item.title: Elon Musk shares 'whole schedule' on how he spends time with his 14 children
item.description: Elon Musk recently disclosed details regarding his co-parenting schedule for his 14 children. He clarified that his five older children are adults living independently. Musk sees his kids with Claire every other week and his children with Shivon every few days. Contrary to claims, Musk stated that his arrangement is not corporate-like but personal. His children are grouped by their mothers, suggesting limited interaction between half-siblings.

item.title: Boston couple's homemade Dracula castle draws visitors from other states
item.description: In East Boston, a couple has turned their residence into a Halloween wonderland dubbed Nightmare on Moore Street. This extraordinary setup lures visitors from various regions, creating a free, festive atmosphere that delights families and Halloween lovers alike. Utilizing hand-carved foam and chilling light effects, they've crafted a captivating experience for all ages.

item.title: Woman uses inheritance to protect 140-acre Canadian island forest
item.description: Domena Diesing took a significant step by investing her grandmother's legacy to safeguard 140 acres of Lasqueti Island, Canada. By teaming up with the BC Parks Foundation, she secured a permanent conservation status for the land, enhancing a vast connected reserve now exceeding 1,000 acres in the Salish Sea. This project commemorates Alfred Gaensbauer’s enduring dedication to environmental preservation, ensuring a legacy of rich coastal habitats for generations to come.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Georgia parents' $37m verdict cut to $2m, appeals court raises it to $3m
item.description: A couple in Georgia has triumphed in their legal battle, securing a $3 million judgment after an appeals court re-evaluated their son's death case. This decision overturned a previous reduction of a $37 million jury award to just $2 million. Their son, who succumbed to stage-four Burkitt lymphoma, faced complications during his treatment. The court recognized the parents as distinct entities under state law, enabling them to seek higher restitution.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Melinda French Gates says her 2-day rule helps employees know they did a good job
item.description: Melinda French Gates implements a 48-hour feedback rule for employees to manage work conflicts effectively. This approach allows employees to feel secure in their performance evaluations as surprises are avoided. She emphasizes the importance of giving honest feedback with integrity while maintaining respect. Recently, Gates pledged $215 million to improve women's health and called for better accountability in healthcare systems.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Hyderabad student spotted in NYC subway to Chanel runway
item.description: Bhavitha Mandava, originally from Hyderabad, transitioned from architecture studies to international modeling. After being scouted in a New York subway, she debuted with Bottega Veneta. She made history by opening a Chanel show, marking Indian representation in fashion. Recently, Bhavitha was recognized by Instagram with the 2026 Rings Award for her creative impact. This accomplishment highlights her unique journey and contributions to the fashion industry.

item.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ $325M KC Current opens soccer doors for kids
item.description: The Kansas City Current launched a free youth soccer league in July to help children overcome financial barriers to sports. The program provides 120 players aged 8 to 10 with uniforms, Nike cleats and equipment at no cost. Supported by community partners, the initiative also offers coach stipends and referee training for teenagers. The league aims to expand access, support local families and encourage greater participation, particularly among girls.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf donate $1 million to Las Vegas charity
item.description: In a heartwarming display of philanthropy, tennis legends Andre Agassi and Steffi Graf pledged $1 million at a charity gala, bolstering the efforts of Keep Memory Alive, which benefits the Cleveland Clinic Lou Ruvo Center for Brain Health. Agassi was honored for his charitable influence during the event in Las Vegas. This recent contribution adds to their previous donation of $1.5 million, bringing their total support to an impressive $2.

item.title: Tanker with 27 Indian seafarers targeted in first-ever limpet mine attack in Hormuz
item.description: On October 29 and 30, two oil tankers were targeted in separate attacks in the Strait of Hormuz. MT LOUISE 1 was struck by limpet mines that caused a fire in its engine room. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil export routes, connecting the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. It has faced repeated security incidents since the conflict between US and Iran began.
item.dc:creator: KANCHAN YADAV

item.title: Isro’s NVS-03 launch successful: Navigation satellite placed in orbit; NavIC gets a boost
item.description: GSLV-F18 carrying 2,250kg next-generation navigation satellite -- NVS-03 -- lifted off from the second launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) in Sriharikota at 11.51pm on Friday, as scheduled. Around 18 minutes later, NVS-03 satellite was placed in a geosynchronous transfer orbit (GTO) of 37,023km apogee and 170km perigee.

item.description: Manisha Bhanwala defeated American Abigail Nette 8-6 in a thrilling comeback victory in the final to become the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World Championships gold. But behind this historic achievement was a personal story of loss, family sacrifices and a promise she had made to herself.

item.title: Payday to mayday: The hike mirage and why bigger salaries still feel smaller
item.description: In India, salary increases of approximately 9% are falling short against the backdrop of soaring living costs and inflation. Families are grappling with heightened expenses on essentials like food and fuel, resulting in diminished disposable incomes. This widening gap between income growth and the cost of living places a strain on households, particularly those with fixed financial obligations.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Paid to hire, paid to work: Inside India’s Rs 99,446 cr plan to reshape formal workforce
item.description: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY) is introduced to enhance formal employment across various sectors. The scheme includes financial incentives for both employers and first-time employees entering the formal job market. PMVBRY aims to create more than 3.5 crore jobs including 1.92 crore first-time workers by 2027. It targets an increase in manufacturing employment with unique incentives for the sector.

item.title: $6.3bn gone in 20 mins: How North Korean hackers pulled off biggest crypto heist
item.description: Hackers executed the largest theft in cryptocurrency history by stealing $6.36 billion from Binance wallets. The theft involved moving funds across 10 blockchains in a short time span. TRM Labs has linked the attack to TraderTraitor, an elite hacking unit from North Korea. Binance has committed to covering all losses through its Secure Asset Fund for Users.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: ‘Class 12-pass mafia’: Ritabrata Banerjee hits back at Abhishek's warning to cops
item.description: Ritabrata Banerjee has responded strongly to Abhishek Banerjee's warning issued to West Bengal police officers. He accused Abhishek of arrogance and urged the state government to take action against him. Additionally, Ritabrata challenged Abhishek to visit a temple alone without security, disputing his claim of public support. Abhishek had recently expressed concerns about police targeting TMC workers and claimed to have a list of implicated officers.

item.title: 'I want teams to fear Mumbai Indians even when we play away': New batting coach
item.description: Mumbai Indians batting coach Robin Uthappa wants the team to become a force not just at the Wankhede Stadium but also at every other venue in the IPL. He believes the five-time champions must win back the trust of their fans after a disappointing 2025 season. Mumbai Indians finished ninth among 10 teams in IPL 2025. Uthappa knows the team, under head coach Kieron Pollard, has a lot of work to do to return to its winning ways.

item.title: 'No' to peace bond, 'yes' to INDIA bloc: Has Neha Bora outsmarted CJP leaders?
item.description: AISA leader Neha Bora's refusal to sign peace bonds led to obvious comparisions with the CJP leadership who opted to comply with conditions set for their release from detention during Jantar Mantar 2.0 protests. The CJP faced significant challenges in organizing Jantar Mantar 2.0 protests which was a contrast from their previous successful mobilization. Bora's determination to protest despite multiple detentions brought her to the centre stage of anti-SIR protests.

item.title: Two days of rain bring Delhi’s AQI down to 60; minister credits ‘targeted action’
item.description: Delhi has experienced significant improvements in air quality due to recent rainfall and government initiatives. The average Air Quality Index for October was lower compared to previous years. Rainfall contributed significantly, with over eight times the normal monthly amount recorded. Public participation in anti-pollution measures is acknowledged by officials as a vital factor for change.

item.title: Big Tech's AI spending spree puts over $2 trillion in Nasdaq market value at risk
item.description: As concerns rise over the Nasdaq 100, which faces risks surpassing $2 trillion this month, investors are questioning the viability of major AI investments. With firms like Meta and Alphabet boosting their spending projections, uncertainties around profitability loom large. However, positive results from Microsoft and SpaceX provide a hopeful contrast to an otherwise declining market.

item.title: Dravid, Sehwag named in India squad for U19 Asia Cup
item.description: Anvay Dravid and Aaryavir Sehwag have been named in India's squad for the upcoming ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup. The tournament will be held in Muscat, Oman, from November 5 to 14. The 17-year-old Anvay and 19-year-old Aaryavir earned their places after impressive performances in the recently concluded Vinoo Mankad Trophy.

item.title: Reliance Q2 results: RIL posts record Rs 29,550 crore quarterly profit
item.description: Reliance Industries Limited announced impressive figures for FY27, with consolidated gross revenue peaking at Rs 3,62,268 crore. The company experienced a remarkable profit growth of 33.8%, reaching Rs 29,550 crore, largely due to a stellar 67.9% rise in oil-to-chemicals segment EBITDA. While retail revenue saw a 6.4% improvement, challenges persisted in that sector. Moreover, the quarter's capital expenditure of Rs 38,153 crore predominantly targeted O2C and New Energy.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Two friends turn $15 Denver haunted house into 18 Halloween attractions
item.description: Two friends, Chris Stafford and Warren Conard, opened a haunted house in a Denver shopping complex in 2002, charging $15 per ticket. What began as a side business has grown into a multimillion-dollar company with 18 seasonal Halloween attractions across the US. The company paid around 4,500 workers during the 2025 Halloween season and is now expanding into Christmas entertainment.
